as_told.title: Rangemen took the tall whites for ancient Egyptians because of their hieroglyphic writing

plain: In the 1960s, some of the men working alongside Charles Hall in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, saw the tall pale beings he calls the Tall Whites and took them for ancient Egyptians who had somehow got into the valley, become trapped there, and were still writing in their own hieroglyphics. Hall, a former Air Force weather observer who says he spent three years among these beings near Area 51, tells this on two episodes as something his fellow rangemen believed. He tells it because the beings looked human enough to be mistaken for an ancient people.
